Map legend and depth notes

Seafloor relief shows the uppermost detected solid terrain. Biome colours are classification, not depth. Hatched areas do not have a confirmed solid surface in the supplied terrain data.

Deeper sampled open-space levels

The combined geography shows the deepest sampled open voxel at each X/Z coordinate. Colours do not show accurate floor depth, lava surfaces, navigable clearance or verified routes.

Some areas have missing terrain batches or suspicious uniform-empty batches. Those source-data uncertainties are omitted from the normal artwork, not interpreted as safe passages.

Navigation schematic, not a measured deck plan. Upper and lower entrances highlight their own access paths plus shared corridors and rooms. Dim connections belong to the other entrance approach.

Terrain coverage notes
Source terrain is incomplete at some depths. Blank or unverified areas do not establish rock, open water or a traversable route. Some uniformly empty source blocks have also been flagged for review. The selected layer shows its individual data coverage.

About this build

Rendered from the user-provided Subnautica terrain archive and original biome map. Community location coordinates are references, not independently verified routes.

Unofficial, free Survivor Incognito fan project. Subnautica is the property of Unknown Worlds Entertainment. Public beta v0.9 — location references, terrain coverage and navigation guidance remain subject to correction.

Data credits and verification

Terrain geometry and biome classification use locally supplied game data. Reference coordinates and possible wreck discoveries have been checked against community sources including the Subnautica Wiki and Rocketsoup’s numbered wreck inventory. Wreck locations and possible finds remain approximate.

Map artwork is newly rendered by Survivor Incognito from source data. The atlas does not reproduce Rocketsoup's geographical artwork.
